design.decision: Don't overbid, because a set loses the multiplier. It also stops multiplying your losses on a set.
design.opponent: Shown on the first make. Opponents can deny it only by setting.
design.rationale: This is the generic common +mult. Its make condition gives honest bid tension at the lowest complexity (C=2), unlike the stat-stick flat multiplier.
design.draftText: +6 contract multiplier if your team makes its contract

history.note: draft-common: the enumerator also produced this signature (e-make-mult); credited to both sources.
